210: Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Bed
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-210-sequoia-molded-wood-grain-behavioral-health-bed
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/sequoia-series-beds/molded-wood-grain-bed/
Spec sheets: 210, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Bed – 210 / 210S2
Current H1: Cortech Sequoia Durable Molded Wood Grain Behavioral Health Bed - 210
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Platform Bed with a Wood Grain Finish, Rounded Edges, and Optional Ballast Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech 210 Sequoia Behavioral Health Bed with Molded Wood Grain Finish
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Bed is a one-piece molded platform bed with a wood grain finish, for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. It brings the warmth of a residential wood bed with the strength and cleanability of molded polyethylene.
The bed is rotationally molded as a single unit from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and its rounded edges and sloped surfaces help reduce ligature risk. It bolts to the floor with a concealed corner mounting system, and optional underside ballast doors take sandbags.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 82”L×42”W×18”H
Weight: 126 lbs
Mattress: Fits a 36”×80” mattress up to 6” thick (sold separately)
Safety: Rounded edges and sloped surfaces help reduce ligature risk
Storage: No shelves or storage
Ballast Doors: Optional underside ballast doors for adding sandbags, secured with tamper-resistant screws; do not use loose sand
Floor Mounting: Bolts to the floor with a concealed corner mounting system
Finishes: Heritage Oak, Natural Oak, Coastal Driftwood, Walnut, or Redwood wood grain (custom wood grain finishes available on request)
Wood Grain: Like natural wood, each piece varies slightly in color and grain
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Award: The Sequoia Series earned a 2025 Gold Nightingale Award in the Anti-Ligature and Reduced-Ligature Furnishings category
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
210 – Standard: Without ballast doors
210S2 – With Ballast Doors: Underside ballast doors for adding sandbags
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Mounting brackets, concrete anchors, and security Torx bolts are included; see Cortech instructions
Ballast Doors: Add sandbags through the underside ballast doors on the 210S2; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Sequoia Bed suits patient rooms that want a warm, residential look without giving up safety or durability.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and secure treatment programs
Other secure settings that want a residential bedroom
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Patient Safety Beds and Bed Restraints collections for more beds and patient room furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Beds
Cortech beds are rotationally molded in one piece for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and cells in correctional facilities, where beds must be safe, strong, and easy to clean.
Cortech beds include:
Solstice Series: The Solstice Bed, and the Solstice Safeguard Bed with raised side panels for fall-risk patients
Sequoia Series: Molded beds and night stands with a wood grain finish
Endurance Series: Endurance beds, wall mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (56 characters): Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Bed - 210 at Anchortex
Meta description (158 characters): Shop the Cortech Sequoia Bed. A one-piece molded platform bed with a wood grain finish, rounded edges, and optional ballast doors for behavioral health rooms.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Beds" is a new section for the Solstice and Sequoia bed pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Platform Bed. I took out "Durable" and "Behavioral Health," and added the 210S2.
Weight: your variants are set to 126 lbs, which matches the Cortech spec sheet.
Finishes: your current page lists four finishes. The Cortech spec sheet also lists Redwood (210RW), so I added it.
210S2: your variant says "2 ballast doors." The Cortech spec sheet says the underside ballast doors are optional but does not give the number of doors or a model number. I kept your 210S2 variant.
Mounting hardware: the Cortech installation instructions say the mounting brackets, concrete anchors, and security Torx bolts are included. Your current page lists a 210KIT bolt-down hardware kit. Is the kit still sold separately?
Award: the Nightingale Award comes from your current page and the Cortech web page.
I left out GREENGUARD Gold, UL 94 HB, and "Patent Pending," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Product images: the page has five images, including a Sequoia finish chart. The Cortech product page has photos of the bed in all five finishes, including Redwood. Would you like me to add the Redwood photo?
